JOHN BROWN lost his mother and a sister when their home was destroyed, and we extend to him our deepest sympathies. John himself was taken to hospital for a short while as he sustained minor injuries.
Belgrave Harriers regret to announce the death of John “Jack” Brown who passed away on 24 September in his 84th year. He had spent his last years in a nursing home.
